verification_contracts: an execution receipt binds exact input source digests, checker/tool identity digest and manifest, environment identity, and a separate attestor distinct from the proposer; executor invariance is the licensed test - the same exact artifact chain receives the same authority stage regardless of executor class while self-review still blocks
dependency closure is load-bearing: the transitive dependency manifest of what executed must equal the declared closure (equality, not subset)

state_ids: three attestation stages held distinct: candidate-passed-checks, active-state-descends-from-candidate, exact-active-state post-validation - deployment is never inferred from authorization
exact rollback parent recorded for every promoted execution (immutable lineage)

transition_semantics: deterministic replay is the ground transition: identical input digests + checker identity + environment identity must reproduce the receipt or emit a typed divergence (nondeterminism is declared, never discovered); a receipt whose inputs no longer re-resolve at their digests transitions to CANNOT_CHECK, not to trusted history
